title: The QQ-equality tests whether order effects are projective

statements.text: Projective models of question order satisfy the Wang-Busemeyer QQ-equality $p(A_y B_n) + p(A_n B_y) - p(B_y A_n) - p(B_n A_y) = 0$, while models with positive operator valued measures can violate it, so the equality tests whether a projective model applies.

sources.quote: We found that, for such observables, the QQ-equality can be violated
The QQ-equality (as well as RRE) can be used as the complimentary test to determine whether QOE can be portrayed with the projective measurements
